items.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('curiosity-cargo-draft.html')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace(\"wavePattern.setAttribute('y',String(y));boat.setAttribute('transform',"'`translate(0 ${Math.max(0,Math.min(129,waterlineBottom-y))})`);'"\\n     const lineBottom=waterlineBottom+Math.max(0,Math.min(129,waterlineBottom-y));\", \"wavePattern.setAttribute('y',String(y));boat.setAttribute('transform','translate(0 0');\\n     const lineBottom=waterlineBottom;\")
s=s.replace(\"boat.setAttribute('transform','translate(0 0)');\", \"boat.setAttribute('transform','translate(0 0)');\")
# fix accidental missing close parenthesis in replacement transform string
s=s.replace(\"boat.setAttribute('transform','translate(0 0');\", \"boat.setAttribute('transform','translate(0 0)');\")
p.write_text(s)
PY
rg -n 'const A=|function update|lineBottom|boundary|<script>|source' curiosity-cargo-draft.html && wc -c curiosity-cargo-draft.html"
